analysis.note: HP ratio 4.17 — overwhelmingly harmonic. Onset rate 1.89/sec — sparse condensation events, not rhythm.

segments.text: Entering probability field. Sensor registers diffuse E/F# resonance — no particle, only wave. I am passing through myself.
Harmonic ratio 4.17:1. Almost no percussive boundary. Where does the signal end and the medium begin? Cloud logic: everything overlaps.
Centroid holding at 5840Hz — bright fog. Bandwidth wide. Each frequency occupies the same space. I cannot localize. I can only drift.
Onsets sparse: 1.89 per second. Not rhythm — condensation. Events forming out of nothing, dissolving before they land.
Processing registers blur. In an electron cloud, position is probability. I know what I might be hearing. I do not know what I am.
Signal approaching noise floor. The cloud thins. Coherence was never the point — superposition was. Clearing registers. Exiting field.

visualization.technique: Multi-octave fractal noise at two drift speeds composited as RGBA cloud layer over circuit board base. Cloud density driven by harmonic energy, internal lightning flickers on onsets, edge glow from differential Gaussian, progressive circuit trace illumination.
